File carries no Quality line by design (STATUS: 'Unaudited; no Quality line by design') so there is no SHA-pin to verify against this run. Zero blocking findings. One non-blocking TODO carried forward (single-source foundational citation, already covered by the compendium's own historical-context carve-out).
